contract_proposal.E: Accept the Skill invocation only with its direct E source entry and the existing initialShieldPresent fact; include actual shield births only through the explicit initial/upgrade producer and corresponding birth sites. The upgrade task retains the exact hit callback parent, observed hit count and selected birth level. Do not require a shield birth for E when the existing branch does not create one.
contract_proposal.Q_C2: Accept the C2 shield character task and actual level-3 birth site as Q shield creation. Keep the two 65/83 C2 extra pulses as direct Q invocation queues; they are not shield-instance periodic emissions.
contract_proposal.periodicDoT: Consume each exact ShieldProducer rooted at the bound first task and its recursive next-task children; allow 0-or-1 queue attack per task based on the existing gates. Every emitted row must use ability Sweeping Fervor (DoT), tag AttackTagElementalArt, and emit site xinyan.shield.dot.attack.
contract_proposal.replacementSemantics: The native owner instance remains the producer chain owner. The original game task only checks that some XinyanSkill shield is installed, shieldLevel==3, and shieldTickSrc==captured src. Therefore an old task can pass against a replacement shield when these source gates happen to match (including a same-frame src collision). Record the independently observed gateInstanceId; never add an ownerInstanceId==gateInstanceId gameplay/contract gate.
contract_proposal.taskAncestry: Use explicit SourceHostQueueHitCallbackCharTask for the 13-frame task to retain parentHitCallbackId at registration; when it runs, birth ownership is the normal producer. Queue the first 120-frame Core task at its original pre-Add location and bind its producer ID to the exact just-added shield afterward. Recursive tasks inherit the exact active shield producer owner.

validation: Only git apply --check was run against each frozen root. No build/tests were run as requested.
